message.content:
This document is a technical README and set of engineering notes for **Project Maya**, an open-source inference engine for large MoE models (GLM-5.3-Flash, DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash, MiniMax-M3.1-Flash) on NVIDIA and AMD hardware. Key technical points:

**Models & quants**
- GLM-5.3-Flash: 320B total / 18B active, 45 layers (3 dense + 42 MoE, 288 experts top-8), 34 KDA linear-attention + 11 DSA/MLA layers, m
